contract_answer.question: Does replacing the adaptive gate MLP with a constant g=0.12 worsen the GateRepair parent enough across the three paper splits to credit the adaptive gate?
contract_answer.conclusion: Independent recomputation from the 600 selected-checkpoint predictions (epoch 23) gives split-2024 MAPE 0.154120, Acc@15 0.5250, RMSE 30.464 cycles, bias -0.763, prediction/target std 45.45/40.39, versus NA-E011 MAPE 0.109135, Acc@15 0.7433, RMSE 24.310, bias +0.514, std 44.88/40.39 (delta MAPE +0.044984). Prefix bands (ablation vs parent): 01-10 0.1570 vs 0.1539; 11-25 0.1654 vs 0.1337; 26-50 0.1823 vs 0.1370; 51-75 0.1425 vs 0.0884; 76-100 0.1297 vs 0.0693. Per-cell MAPE: 3-1-56 0.0797 vs 0.0596; 3-2-55 0.1568 vs 0.1009; 4-1-48 0.0357 vs 0.0416; 5-2-38 0.1630 vs 0.0714; 6-2-30 0.2584 vs 0.1832; 7-1-23 0.2312 vs 0.1982. Family 3-split MAPE 0.146409 +/- 0.038529 (sample std) versus parent 0.108654 +/- 0.008549; mean delta +0.037755, meeting the +0.008 credit threshold, so the component is credited.

main_symptom: Split 2024: ablation MAPE 0.1541 vs parent 0.1091 (+0.0450); family mean +0.0378 worse than parent with sample std 0.0385. Diagnostics are finite, padding-invariant, with overall_gradient_health=WARNING from branch imbalance (ext_da/tcn_norm ratio 2.62e+06).

causes.interpretation: A prefix- and state-dependent blend is needed: a constant g cannot rise with prefix length the way the parent gate does, so late-prefix errors grow on every split. On this split removal worsens MAPE by +0.0450.
missing_evidence: Repeated-seed variance within each locked split

causes.interpretation: Six validation cells per split and one seed; magnitude of the effect may vary with initialization, although all three splits move in the same direction.
missing_evidence: Matched reruns with different initialization seeds on the same locked splits
